newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Costa Rica cuts sales tax to 13 pct from 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica cuts sales tax to 13 pct from 15 pct.

text.p: Costa Rica announced Wednesday a reduction of 2 percentage points in the nation's sales tax to 13 percent.
The Finance Ministry, announcing the cut in newspapers, said the reduction will be effective immediately and warned it would sanction outlets that do not tax at the new lower rate.
Costa Rica raised its sales tax to 15 percent from 10 percent on September 19, 1995 for a period of 18 months.
The government said the cut would see revenues fall by just less than $70 million in 1997, although they should be offset by greater coffee export income from higher bean prices.
